Section D08 Mentors: Gabriel Andres Garzo, Tamar Schaap

1. What is the most interesting topic covered in your domain this quarter? The most interesting topic so far has been understanding the strategies that play into optimizing GEO. Over the summer, I worked a little bit in marketing platforms that helped boost optimization for generative engines, so it was interesting seeing a direct application to how generative engine optimization could help businesses.

2. Describe a potential investigation you would like to pursue for your Quarter 2 Project. Our original idea was to continue our dashboard from Quarter 1, assuming that in the first quarter, we would work on assembling all the pieces separately. If that is not fit for quarter 2, then I would imagine we could run a study related to AI optimization. It would utilize the dashboard we create in Quarter 1, but put more of our findings into action by running different A/B tests from our findings. Or we can add another element to our dashboard, like some sort of AI chatbot that we can ask questions about the data on.

3. What is a potential change you’d make to the approach taken in your current Quarter 1 Project? If the professor doesn’t want us to continue our dashboard into quarter 2, then the dashboard creation will have to be condensed into quarter 1. I think with my track so far, there hasn’t been as much technical work yet. I would like to be more hands on in creating the dashboard and testing out the data connections from now on for the rest of quarter 1.

4. What other techniques would you be interested in using in your project? I would be interested in tapping more into the API work, especially with making our queries more structured. I think making different personas under each set of prompts would be more useful for understanding what each customer is asking and how they perceive the clinic. From what I read in the research articles and listened to in the podcast, a large volume of queries is also necessary to better understand the potential customer.
